Hi Hannah —

Apologies — we've just locked travel for a leadership offsite and our primary attendee (Head of Platforms) is traveling to re:Invent that week. Can we either 1) consolidate to a shorter executive summary the week before, or 2) rotate coverage so we can still keep the full technical demo the week after the company-wide ops freeze (week of 11/30)?

Option 1 is best if you can deliver a 20–25 minute summary (exec + high-level economics) next Tue/Wed. If not, option 2 works but we'll need a proposed rotation table showing who covers which parts and an alternative date.

Thanks — Sarah

Thanks for the heads up, Sarah — totally understand. Two quick asks: 1) if you prefer the condensed exec summary, is Tues 11/17 10:00am PT or Wed 11/18 9:00am PT preferable? 2) if you want the full tech run-through the week of 11/30, I’ll circulate a rotation proposal that hands off parts of the demo across our team so we don’t lose fidelity.

Ben is on the E2E benchmarks and Marcus holds the deployment playbook; Soojin can cover pricing implications and SLAs. I’ve attached a draft rotation spreadsheet (proposed-rotation-table.xlsx) — it maps segments to owners and fallback contacts.

If you'd like the condensed exec deck I can cut the attached PDF to a 20-minute script and send tomorrow.

Best,

- Full technical demo (45') — week of 11/30, Tue 12/1 11:00am PT; primary Marcus, backup Ben
- Pre-demo checklist: Sarah to confirm attendee list and top-3 success criteria by 11/18 EOD
